title: Pure Tenpai Dragon
summary: Pure Tenpai Dragon and Sangen OTK strategy centered on Level 3 and 4 FIRE Dragons that perform Synchro Summons during the Battle Phase. Operating with complete effect immunity during Main Phase 1 under Sangen Summoning, the deck forces the opponent into battle, repeatedly Synchro climbing mid-combat to deliver game-ending attacks.

summary.title: Starters
points: Tenpai Dragon Paidra adds or Sets a Sangen Spell or Trap card directly from your Deck to your field on Normal or Special Summon, and initiates Synchro Summons during the Battle Phase.

Sangen Summoning searches any Tenpai Dragon monster from your Deck on activation, and makes all FIRE Dragon monsters you control completely unaffected by your opponent's activated effects during your Main Phase 1.

Tenpai Dragon Genroku Special Summons itself from the hand as a Tuner whenever a card is added to your hand outside the Draw Phase, and tributes itself to Special Summon any Tenpai Dragon from your Deck.
Tenpai Dragon Chundra Special Summons itself from hand while you control a FIRE Dragon, and Special Summons a FIRE Dragon from your Deck at the start of the Damage Step when a monster battles.
Tenpai Dragon Fadra revives a Level 4 or lower FIRE Dragon from your GY on summon, and prevents all FIRE Dragon monsters you control from being destroyed by battle.

summary.title: Opening: Paidra + Sangen Summoning
steps: Activate Sangen Summoning to search Tenpai Dragon Chundra, establishing blanket effect immunity for all your FIRE Dragons during Main Phase 1.
Normal Summon Tenpai Dragon Paidra and activate its effect to Set Sangen Kaimen directly from your Deck.
Special Summon Tenpai Dragon Chundra from your hand because you control a FIRE Dragon.
Enter the Battle Phase and declare an attack with Chundra, triggering Chundra at the start of the Damage Step to Special Summon Tenpai Dragon Fadra from your Deck.
During the Battle Phase, activate Paidra's Quick Effect to Synchro Summon Sangenpai Bident Dragion, then climb into Sangenpai Transcendent Dragion or Trident Dragion for multiple lethal strikes.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Sangenpai Transcendent Dragion is a Level 10 Synchro that forces all opponent monsters to attack if able, prevents the opponent from activating cards or effects during the Battle Phase, and revives itself from the GY after 3 or more attacks have been declared in a turn.

Sangenpai Bident Dragion is a Level 7 Synchro Tuner that revives a Level 7 or lower FIRE Dragon on summon, locks you into Dragons, and revives itself from the GY when 3 or more attacks have been declared in a turn.
Trident Dragion destroys up to 2 other cards you control on Synchro Summon to gain up to 2 additional attacks during each Battle Phase, hitting for 3000 ATK three times.
Black-Winged Assault Dragon and Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon provide burn damage and monster effect negation respectively when laddered through Bident.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Sangen Kaimen adds a FIRE Dragon from Deck to hand, and if activated during the Battle Phase, can immediately Special Summon a FIRE Dragon from your hand.
Sangen Kaiho negates the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent controls for the turn and prevents them from activating effects, and draws 1 card after 3 attacks are declared in a turn.
Sangen Furo revives a monster destroyed by battle with your FIRE Dragon in Defense Position and Sets a Sangen card from your GY.
